name: Cosine Annealing
description: Smoothly decreases learning rate from peak to minimum following a cosine curve.
commonUse: Default choice for most LLM training. Works well with warmup.
rule: Peak LR then decay to ~10% over the full token horizon.
whenToUse: Default for pretraining and most fine-tuning.
failureModes: Wrong horizon (schedule ends before/after training does).

name: Linear Warmup
description: Ramps learning rate from 0 to target over the first N steps.
commonUse: Almost always used at the start of LLM training. Prevents early instability.
rule: 1-3% of total steps, linear ramp from 0.
whenToUse: Start of essentially every LLM run (lets Adam stats stabilize).
failureModes: Skipped warmup + large batch = NaN at step ~0.

name: Constant
description: Keeps learning rate fixed throughout training.
commonUse: Rarely used for pretraining. Sometimes used for fine-tuning.
rule: Only with early stopping; never for pretraining.
whenToUse: Short fine-tunes with explicit step budgets.
failureModes: No settling phase - final weights noisier.

name: One-Cycle
description: Ramps up then down in a single cycle. Combines warmup and decay.
commonUse: Sometimes used for fine-tuning. Less common for pretraining.
rule: Peak at ~30% of the run, anneal after.
failureModes: Restart spikes wiping fine-tuned behavior on short runs.
